buckets.name: Passenger & Light-Duty EVs
buckets.scope: OEMs and platforms for electric cars and personal light vehicles (commercial vans/trucks/buses are in the Commercial & Off-Road bucket)
variations: pure-play battery-electric carmakers (Tesla, BYD, NIO, XPeng, Rivian, Lucid, VinFast, Zeekr)
incumbent OEM EV programs & sub-brands (VW ID., GM Ultium, Hyundai Ioniq, BMW i, Toyota bZ)
extended-range EV (EREV) specialists (Li Auto, Leapmotor, Scout Motors)
solar-integrated EVs (Aptera, Lightyear legacy, Sono solar retrofit)
microcars, quadricycles & low-speed EVs (Microlino, Citroen Ami, Wuling Mini, Eli Zero)
EV skateboard platforms & contract manufacturers (Foxconn MIH, Magna Steyr, REE, U Power)
ICE-to-EV passenger conversions & classic-car retrofits (Everrati, Electrogenic, Transition-One)

buckets.name: Electric Two/Three-Wheelers & Micromobility
buckets.scope: OEMs of electric motorcycles, scooters, rickshaws, e-bikes and shared micromobility fleets (battery-swap networks are in the Charging bucket)
variations: electric motorcycles (Zero Motorcycles, LiveWire, Ultraviolette, Can-Am)
electric scooters & mopeds (Gogoro, NIU, Ather, Ola Electric, Yadea, TVS, Bajaj Chetak)
electric three-wheelers & rickshaws for passenger transport (Mahindra Last Mile, Piaggio Ape E, Euler, OSM)
cargo e-bikes & electric delivery trikes (Urban Arrow, ONOMOTION, Fernhay, EAV)
e-bikes & e-bike drive systems (Bosch eBike, Bafang, Rad Power, Specialized Turbo)
shared micromobility fleet operators (Lime, Voi, Dott, Beam)
two-wheeler electric conversion/retrofit kits (RTO-approved kit makers, e.g. GoGoA1)

buckets.name: Commercial, Heavy-Duty & Off-Road EVs
buckets.scope: Battery-electric trucks, vans, buses and off-highway equipment OEMs (hydrogen vehicles are in the Rail/Hydrogen/E-fuels bucket)
variations: heavy-duty electric trucks, semis & electric freight services (Tesla Semi, Volvo, Daimler, BYD, Windrose, Einride)
medium-duty & vocational trucks incl. refuse and utility (Harbinger, Xos, Battle Motors, Mack LR Electric)
electric delivery & step vans (BrightDrop, Rivian EDV, Flexis, Farizon)
transit buses & coaches (BYD, Yutong, New Flyer, Solaris, Ebusco)
electric school buses (Blue Bird, GreenPower, Thomas Built, Micro Bird)
construction & compact equipment (Volvo CE, Komatsu, Bobcat, XCMG)
mining trucks & underground equipment (Epiroc, Sandvik, Fortescue Zero, MEDATech)
agricultural tractors & farm equipment (Monarch, Solectrac, John Deere, Fendt)
port/terminal tractors, airport ground support & material handling (Orange EV, Kalmar, ITW GSE, Toyota MH)
truck & bus repower/retrofit conversions (Pepper Motion, Evolectric, Lightning eMotors legacy)

buckets.name: EV Charging & Grid Integration
buckets.scope: Charging networks, hardware, battery swapping, V2G and charging software across all vehicle classes
variations: public DC fast-charging networks & CPOs (Tesla Supercharger, Ionity, EVgo, Fastned, Electrify America)
charging hardware manufacturers (Alpitronic, Kempower, ABB E-mobility, Autel, BTC Power)
home & workplace AC/L2 charging (ChargePoint, Wallbox, Emporia, Ohme)
fleet & depot charging / electrification-as-a-service (Voltera, Terawatt, Greenlane, Forum Mobility)
megawatt charging systems (MCS) for heavy trucks (Milence, WattEV, ABB MCS)
battery swapping for cars and 2/3-wheelers (NIO, Ample, CATL EVOGO, Gogoro Network, Battery Smart, Sun Mobility)
wireless/inductive charging & electric road systems (WiTricity, InductEV, Electreon)
V2G/bidirectional & managed-charging software (Nuvve, Fermata Energy, ev.energy, WeaveGrid, Kaluza)
battery-buffered, off-grid, solar-canopy & mobile chargers (ADS-TEC, Jolt, Beam Global, SparkCharge)
charging software platforms, roaming & payments (Monta, Driivz, Hubject, AMPECO)

buckets.name: Battery Cells & Next-Gen Chemistries
buckets.scope: EV battery cell manufacturers and novel cell-chemistry developers (materials, packs, recycling are in the Components bucket)
variations: incumbent giga-scale cell makers (CATL, BYD FinDreams, LG Energy Solution, Panasonic, Samsung SDI, SK On, EVE, CALB)
challenger & regional cell manufacturers (ACC, Verkor, PowerCo, AESC, ONE, Amplify Cell, Northvolt-successor Lyten)
solid-state batteries (QuantumScape, Solid Power, Factorial, ProLogium, Toyota program)
lithium-metal & anode-free cells (SES AI, Ion Storage Systems, Pure Lithium)
silicon-anode cell makers (Amprius, Enovix, Ionblox)
lithium-sulfur cells (Lyten, Theion, Zeta Energy)
sodium-ion for mobility (CATL Naxtra, HiNa, BYD, Faradion)
LFP/LMFP & manganese-rich cell innovation (Our Next Energy, Integrals Power)
extreme-fast-charge & niobium/LTO cells (StoreDot, Nyobolt, Echion, Toshiba SCiB)
high-power specialty cells for e-aviation & performance (Molicel, Cuberg legacy)

buckets.name: Battery Materials, Components, Powertrain & Recycling
buckets.scope: Active materials, cell and pack components, EV powertrain hardware, battery software, manufacturing equipment, recycling and second-life
variations: cathode active materials & precursors (Umicore, BASF, EcoPro, Nano One, Redwood cathode)
anode materials: graphite, synthetic & silicon (Novonix, Vianode, Anovion, Sila, Group14, OneD)
electrolytes, separators & inactive cell components (Enchem, Soulbrain, Celgard, Entek)
EV powertrain: motors, e-axles, inverters & SiC power electronics (YASA, Equipmake, BorgWarner, Wolfspeed)
packs, modules, enclosures & thermal management incl. cell-to-pack and immersion cooling (XING Mobility)
BMS & battery health analytics software (TWAICE, Zitara, ACCURE, Elysia)
battery manufacturing equipment & dry-electrode processing (Wuxi Lead, AM Batteries, LiCAP)
hydrometallurgical & pyrometallurgical recycling (Redwood Materials, Ascend Elements, Li-Cycle, Hydrovolt, Altilium, tozero)
direct & cathode-to-cathode recycling (Princeton NuEnergy, hydro-to-cathode processes)
second-life EV battery stationary storage (B2U, Connected Energy, Moment Energy, Octave)

buckets.name: Aviation Decarbonization
buckets.scope: SAF production pathways, zero/low-emission aircraft and propulsion, and flight-operations efficiency
variations: HEFA sustainable aviation fuel producers (Neste, World Energy, Montana Renewables, EcoCeres)
alcohol-to-jet SAF (LanzaJet, Gevo, Swedish Biofuels)
gasification & Fischer-Tropsch SAF from waste/biomass (DG Fuels, Velocys, Aether Fuels)
power-to-liquid e-SAF (Twelve, Infinium, Synhelion, Air Company, Arcadia eFuels, Norsk e-Fuel)
emerging SAF routes: pyrolysis, HTL, algae, CO2-to-ethanol chains (Alder Renewables, Viridos, LanzaTech chain)
battery-electric fixed-wing aircraft (BETA Technologies, Eviation, Elysian)
hybrid-electric propulsion & retrofits (Heart Aerospace, Ampaire, VoltAero, magniX)
hydrogen fuel-cell & H2-combustion aircraft plus airport H2 fueling (ZeroAvia, Joby/H2FLY, Beyond Aero, Fabrum)
eVTOL & urban air mobility (Joby, Archer, Vertical Aerospace, EHang, Wisk)
flight-ops efficiency & contrail avoidance (SATAVIA, Estuaire, Google/Breakthrough contrail routing)

buckets.name: Maritime Decarbonization
buckets.scope: Alternative marine fuels, electric and wind propulsion, nuclear shipping, onboard capture, and vessel/port efficiency
variations: green methanol vessels, engines & fuel supply (MAN ES/Maersk ecosystem, Liquid Wind, European Energy, WasteFuel)
ammonia propulsion & ammonia-to-power (MAN ES, WinGD, Wartsila, Amogy, Azane bunkering)
hydrogen & fuel-cell vessels (Norled, Future Proof Shipping, e1 Marine, Genevos)
battery-electric ships, ferries, workboats & hydrofoils (Corvus Energy, Fleetzero, Candela, Artemis, Navier, Arc)
wind-assisted propulsion: rotors, rigid wings, suction sails, kites (Norsepower, Anemoi, bound4blue, BAR Technologies, Michelin WISAMO)
primary-sail cargo shipping lines (TOWT, Neoline, Veer, Sailcargo)
drop-in marine biofuels & bio-LNG bunkering (FincoEnergies/GoodFuels, Titan)
onboard carbon capture (Value Maritime, Seabound, Carbon Ridge)
nuclear maritime propulsion (Core Power, HD KSOE programs, Ulstein Thor concept)
vessel & port efficiency: air lubrication, hull coatings/robots, route optimization, shore power (Silverstream, Jotun HullSkater, ZeroNorth, Sofar, Cavotec)

buckets.name: Rail, Hydrogen for Transport & E-fuels

autonomous battery railcars & rail freight innovation (Parallel Systems, Intramotev)
hydrogen trains (Alstom Coradia iLint, Stadler FLIRT H2, CRRC)
rail electrification & discontinuous catenary technology (Furrer+Frey, Hitachi tri-mode)
locomotive repowering & hybrid retrofits (OptiFuel, ZTR)
fuel cell systems for road vehicles & material handling (Ballard, Plug Power, PowerCell, Cellcentric, Symbio)
hydrogen & H2-ICE trucks (Hyundai XCIENT, Cummins H2-ICE, JCB hydrogen engines, Keyou, Hydra Energy retrofits)
hydrogen refueling networks & onboard storage tanks (FirstElement Fuel, OneH2, Hexagon Purus, Verne, Cryomotive, NPROXX)
e-fuels & low-carbon road fuels: e-gasoline, e-diesel, rDME (HIF Global, Infinium, P1 Fuels, Zero Petroleum, Oberon Fuels)
